big_case.notes: Broad Second Amendment challenge on a final summary-judgment record to Maryland's post-Bruen carry bans across transit, parks, healthcare facilities, entertainment venues, alcohol-serving establishments, and public demonstrations. Defining Bruen's 'sensitive places' carve-out is the central open Second Amendment question affecting carry laws across multiple populous states, and even in denial the petition drew five conference distributions and a separate statement from Justice Thomas, though it sits below the highest tier of national structural or federal-statute blockbusters.
